notes.title: New update
notes.content:
[h1]Version 4.4[/h1]
[h2]Release Notes[/h2]

[h3]New[/h3]
 - Added a cooldown to Betty's ability (i.e. cannot be on permanently)
 - Add in-level respawn for infinite mode. An option to return to menu will briefly display after each fall. 

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
 - Fixed an issue where the larger game room size unintentionally reduced difficulty
 - Increased the size of the mouse cursor
 - Fixed an issue where a block transitioning to a crumbling block could spawn a new stalagmite
 - Fixed an issue where having greater than 3 lives displayed misaligned in the HUD
 - Fixed an issue where spikes at the bottom edge of level would fail to display part of their sprite
 - Fixed an issued with spikes spawning inside the level when travelling in reverse
 - Remixed some audio levels

[h1]Version 4.3[/h1]
[h2]Release Notes[/h2]

[h3]New[/h3]
- Increased the base resolution of the game so it will display better on modern hardware
- Improved save game feature
- Increased the game frame rate
- Improved menu layouts and UI
- (iOS) Improved controls to make it easier to move
- Added more hints in dialogue
- Revamped end credits scene

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
- Fixed directional parallax scrolling of the background
- Fixed some unwanted procedural generations
- Fixed up some graphics that had unwanted artifacts
- Fixed particles that were displaying incorrectly
- Other miscellaneous small changes and improvements
- Earthquakes (generating crumbling blocks) will no longer occur during a pause/cutscene
